Name: -CP- Kent Dress Uniform Class A Green
Author: TallLeprechaun13
Description:
Artwork was done by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/suzukiPC]Pau[/url].[u]
[/u]If you wish to modify any parts and post it to a mod site, I must first be asked which will then be forwarded to Pau to determine.

[u]Mod Includes[/u]:
[list]
[*]Dress Uniform sprite and portraits.
[*]Spouse Portrait that adjusts with what config settings are chosen
[/list]
[u]Mod Options[/u]:
How often: Only for events (Community Center reopen, Joja expansion, Wedding ceremony, Flower Dance)

[u]Mod Compatibility[/u]: 
It should be compatible with outfit mods that are for everyone (Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic), [u][b]but it will overwrite their Kent outfits[/b][/u]. However, with how appearance modding works, it is either theirs takes
precedence or this one does, you cannot easily mix and match. Please
message if you have questions.

Why I made Kent a SFC: Made Kent a SFC because he would have served for close to twenty years or more if he got in between the age of 17-21 and his eldest is around 20s depending on how we guestimate the player's age. I also put Kent in an engineering unit because that is what my Grandfather was attached to and thus what I had available for reference. hence why Kent doesn't have the blue cord.

[u]Ribbons from left to right
[/u]Ribbons do not have any oak leaves or other additions as too small to model at this scale
Top row: "Prisoner of War", "Meritorious Service", "Army Commendation"
2nd row: "Army Achievement", "Army Good Conduct", "Reserve Componets Achievement"
3rd row: "National Defense Service", "Humanitarian Service", "Armed Forces Reserve"
4th row: "Army Service", "Overseas Service", "National Guard Service Ribbon"
